name: Instruction Config Integrity Guard
summary: Guard project configuration against explicit enforcement bypasses and observe instruction path drift.
description: A deterministic ConfigChange gate for explicit hook and permission bypasses plus a fail-open InstructionsLoaded observer for project instruction files outside the active project boundary.
risk_reason: This automatic gate guards project configuration against explicit enforcement bypasses and observe instruction path drift; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not block managed policy changes or claim authority over enterprise policy settings.
It does not rewrite settings, instruction files, permissions, or hook configuration.
It does not inspect arbitrary project files or interpret natural-language instructions.
It does not claim that accepted configuration is secure beyond its explicit bounded rules.

entrypoints.purpose: Reject explicit project configuration bypasses and observe unverifiable project instruction paths.

operational.latency_reason: To guard project configuration against explicit enforcement bypasses and observe instruction path drift, the entrypoint inspects bounded session, tool, or repository state.
